_comment: Byte-exact iOS Instagram TLS ClientHello profiles, keyed by app-version prefix. Transcribed from a real rvictl + tshark capture. Extension ORDER matters and must match the JA3 fullstring exactly. The 437 profile below is the FULL-handshake shape (7 extensions, JA4 t13d0207h2); pre_shared_key (ext 41 -> t13d0208) only appears on session resumption and is added dynamically by the TLS stack, never hardcoded.
